translationRepairs: His grandfather Longdao had been northern inspector of Yan Province under Song.
His grandfather Longdao had been inspector of Northern Yan Province under Song.
宋北兗州刺史 names the inspectorate of Northern Yan Province (北兗州), not a northern posting in Yan Province.
When Emperor Wen took up post at Xia Province, he made Hui recording secretary adjutant and concurrently chief clerk of the commandery office.
When Emperor Wen took up post at Xia Province, he made Hui recording secretary adjutant and concurrently chief clerk of the headquarters.
兼府主簿 is concurrent chief clerk of the headquarters (府), not of a commandery (郡).
In the tenth year he was moved to supervising secretary and attendant at the gates.
In the tenth year he was moved to Supervising Secretary and Attendant Gentleman of the Yellow Gates.
給事黃門侍郎 is one Yellow Gate office; the original splits it and omits 黃門.
Hui was scrupulous and wary of corruption; he hung a portrait of Yang Zhen in his sleeping room to keep himself honest.
Hui was scrupulous and wary of corruption; he painted a portrait of Yang Zhen in his sleeping room to keep himself honest.
畫楊震像於寢室 is painting (or having painted) Yang Zhen's likeness, not hanging a ready-made portrait.
They said to one another, "These are Prefect Shen's own lines."
They said to one another, "This is Prefect Shen's own handwriting."
手跡 means handwriting or autograph, not the poem's verse lines.
He served as junior minister of works and junior guardian, went out as inspector of Jing Province, and returned as junior minister of worship and junior minister of ritual.
He served as junior minister of works and junior guardian, went out as inspector of Jing Province, and returned as junior minister of the masses and junior minister of ritual.
入為小司徒、小宗伯 pairs junior Minister of the Masses with junior minister of ritual; 小司徒 is not a minister of worship.
Lu Tong also marched when the siege of Luoyang was lifted.
Lu Tong again took part in lifting the siege of Luoyang.
又從解洛陽圍 means he again took part in raising the Luoyang siege, not that he merely marched as it was already lifted.
Emperor Wen once said to him at leisure, "You are already mild and generous—why style yourself Hero of the Age?
Emperor Wen of Wei once said to him at leisure, "You are already mild and generous—why style yourself Hero of the Age?
魏文帝 specifies the Wei emperor; dropping 魏 would conflate him with Zhou's posthumous Emperor Wen.
In the third year of Tianhe Qi sent Attendant-in-Ordinary Husiwen Lue and Secretariat Gentleman Liu Ti on a friendly visit.
In the third year of Tianhe, Qi sent Attendant-in-Ordinary Husi Wenlüe and Secretariat Gentleman Liu Ti on a friendly visit.
斛斯文略 is surname 斛斯 plus given name 文略; the original fuses them as Husiwen Lue and also runs Tianhe into Qi.
In the third year of Tianhe, Qi sent Attendant-in-Ordinary Husiwen Lue and Secretariat Gentleman Liu Ti on a friendly mission.
In the third year of Tianhe, Qi sent Attendant-in-Ordinary Husi Wenlüe and Secretariat Gentleman Liu Ti on a friendly mission.
The literal line likewise mis-segments 斛斯文略; Husi Wenlüe restores the Xianbei surname and given name.
Before coming of age he entered service as regular attendant of scattered cavalry outside the office.
Before coming of age he entered service as supernumerary cavalier attendant-in-ordinary.
員外散騎侍郎 is a supernumerary cavalier attendant-in-ordinary, not scattered cavalry posted outside an office.
兼記室 is concurrent recorder; 〔Jian〕 wrongly imports the previous unit's emendation and drops 兼.
When Wei Chijiong marched against Shu, Min was made campaign army marshal.
When Yuchi Jiong marched against Shu, Min was made campaign army marshal.
尉遲迥 is Yuchi Jiong; Wei Chijiong wrongly splits the two-character surname 尉遲.
When Wei Chijiong campaigned against Shu, Min was made army marshal on campaign.
When Yuchi Jiong campaigned against Shu, Min was made army marshal on campaign.
The literal English repeats the same mis-split of 尉遲 as Wei Chi.
Once Sheng was made grand guardian, Rou joined his staff as a general of the victorious army.
When Sheng was made grand guardian, Rou was made his staff officer and given the added rank of Champion General.

以柔為掾，加冠軍將軍 is two acts, 掾 plus Champion General; the original fuses them and mistranslates 冠軍將軍. The proposal is right in substance but the parenthetical (yuan) is an awkward gloss, so the sentence is recast without it.
Learning they were Rou's composition, he sent a palace attendant with condolences and also bestowed silk and brocade.
Learning they were Rou's composition, he sent a palace attendant with greetings and also bestowed silk and brocade.
遣舍人勞問 is a courtesy greeting or inquiry, not funeral condolences.
Soon he was deputy envoy on a marriage mission to Chen.
Soon he was deputy envoy on a diplomatic mission to Chen.
聘陳 is a court embassy to Chen, the same diplomatic 聘 as 來聘, not a marriage mission.
字附璘 transcribes as Fulin; Fulai invents a wrong reading of 璘.
The literal courtesy-name likewise misreads 附璘 as Fulai rather than Fulin.
He took part in breaking Shayuan and fighting at He Bridge, had merit in both, and was enfeoffed viscount of Guniang county.
He took part in breaking Shayuan and fighting at He Bridge, had merit in both, and was enfeoffed viscount of Guzang county.
姑臧縣子 is viscount of Guzang county; Guniang misreads 臧.
Following in breaking Shayuan and fighting at He Bridge, he had merit in both and was enfeoffed viscount of Guniang county.
Following in breaking Shayuan and fighting at He Bridge, he had merit in both and was enfeoffed viscount of Guzang county.
The literal enfeoffment likewise requires Guzang for 姑臧, not Guniang.
He was transferred to minister of the grand commissariat, advanced to grand general of the agile cavalry and opening-office equal in three departments, and granted the surname Yuwen.
He was transferred to minister of revenue, advanced to grand general of the agile cavalry and opening-office equal in three departments, and granted the surname Yuwen.
戶部尚書 is minister of revenue, not minister of the grand commissariat.
He was transferred to minister of the grand commissariat, advanced to grand general of the agile cavalry, opening-office equal in three departments, and granted the surname Yuwen.
He was transferred to minister of revenue, advanced to grand general of the agile cavalry, opening-office equal in three departments, and granted the surname Yuwen.
The literal office title likewise mistranslates 戶部尚書 as grand commissariat.
The unit is an emendation of 休假 with 暇 “leisure,” not a pinyin-only variant gloss; the proposed replacement still put a Chinese character into the English field.
